brief.objective: A French fashion house founded in Paris in 1854 as a trunk maker. Its collections include luggage, handbags, clothing, shoes and accessories.

creativeThesis: One black-and-white Monogram LV Trainer sneaker cuts across three flat colour sets, red, cobalt, yellow, like a moving graphic poster.

intent.message: Louis Vuitton design as bold graphic fashion

realWorldGrounding: actual product photo: LV Trainer sneaker, black Monogram-embossed leather panels, white leather toe and quarters, white flat laces, white LV initials on black tongue and insole
real chunky white rubber cupsole of the LV Trainer
Louis Vuitton founded in Paris in 1854

selectedGoal.title: Colour Block Trainer
selectedGoal.description: The LV Trainer sneaker becomes a graphic shape: it drops, spins and steps across seamless saturated colour sets cut on the beat, while big composed type names only what is on screen. It sells the sneaker as a design object with fashion-film attitude, nothing like trunk heritage or craft macro.
selectedGoal.style: Seamless paper colour sets (signal red, cobalt blue, lemon yellow), hard top light with crisp graphic shadow, 50mm, clean saturated grade, fashion-editorial still-life

styleTags.pacing: three 5s beats, hard cuts on the kick
styleTags.cameraLanguage: locked overhead, low side profile, slow orbit

decisionEvidence.selectedReason: Real LV Trainer shown large on bold colour sets with composed type; on-brand, on-platform 9:16 and distinct from sibling runs.

referencesUsed.title: The Keith Haring Collection | LOUIS VUITTON
referencesUsed.why: Brand campaign film from the official LV channel (found via Tavily search); bold graphic line art and saturated colour against product makes accessories read as graphic shapes. Metrics not verified in time budget, so null.

referencesUsed.title: Men’s Fall-Winter 2026 Show | LOUIS VUITTON
referencesUsed.why: Official LV show film; search snippet reported a view count beginning 10,133,... (truncated, so left null). Transferable: runway rhythm, shoes and bags isolated as moving shapes, cut on the beat.

referencesUsed.title: Louis Vuitton site
referencesUsed.why: The brand's own page image: what the product, logo and palette actually look like.

creative.reason: Bold red/cobalt/yellow colour-block fashion film with the real black/white Monogram LV Trainer sharp and large in every frame, captions and end card set by the compositor. Biggest weakness: caption pills are generic rounded boxes rather than big editorial type, and scene 3 motion is gentle.
creative.biggestProblem: Caption styling is less bold than the kinetic-type concept.

slopHits.note: rounded translucent pills instead of composed type
